topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The opening introduces the themes and learning objectives of the lecture on cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic Selection and Epigenetic Plasticity in Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how both Darwinian selection of somatic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive clonal fitness and expansion.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchies and Cell of Origin in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue stem cell hierarchies and cell-of-origin characteristics dictate cancer initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Support in Cancer Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma cooperate with intrinsic mutations to permit tumor development and maintenance.

topics.label: Advanced Technologies for Mapping Tumor Evolution and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental and computational tools used to resolve the spatial and temporal dynamics of tumor cells and their surrounding tissue.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic alterations, cell-of-origin traits, epigenetic states, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary framework of malignancy.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: The closing concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
